plan.title: Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka temples and neon for Alex and Sam
plan.summary: Tokyo first for shared Senso-ji and Shibuya plus teamLab and Tsukiji, then Kyoto base with Osaka day trip for temples and food nights. Alex and Sam each get about five clear wins with five shared favourites holding the plan together.
tradeoffs: Alex got Kinkaku-ji, Gion at Dusk, teamLab Planets, Akihabara and Osaka Castle while Sam joined even though Sam passed on all five.
Sam got Tsukiji, Golden Gai dinner, Pontocho dinner, Dotonbori and dinner, Kiyomizu-dera and Nishiki Market while Alex joined even though Alex passed on food and nightlife.
Both shared Senso-ji, Shibuya Crossing, Philosophers Path, Fushimi Inari and Kuromon Ichiba Market with no compromise needed.
Alex compromised by skipping Nara Day Trip and Minoo Falls Hike nature daytrips because Sam passed on nature and daytrips, replaced with a shorter Osaka Castle plus Kuromon day.
Sam compromised by keeping nightlife to early dinners in Golden Gai, Pontocho and Dotonbori rather than late nights, respecting that Alex skips nightlife.

days.headline: Arrival, Asakusa temples and Shibuya lights

items.title: Flight arrival from Singapore to Tokyo
items.why: Shared start from Singapore, both picked Senso-ji and Shibuya for day one

items.title: Lunch at Tempura Asakusa SAKURA
items.detail: Tempura Asakusa SAKURA near Senso-ji, order tendon tempura bowl and miso soup
items.why: Both picked Kuromon Ichiba Market for food markets, so starting with market-area lunch near Senso-ji works for both

items.title: Senso-ji Temple
items.detail: Senso-ji Temple in Asakusa, Nakamise street, Hozomon Gate and main hall, 1 hour on foot
items.why: Both picked Senso-ji Temple, the strongest shared culture pick
